letter.role_title: JD Young Marketing Analytics & AI Internship
letter.opening: I am applying for the JD Young Marketing Analytics & AI Internship. Finding what drives the numbers and explaining it simply, and building AI tools that produce reports, is exactly where my analytics experience and my recent LLM project meet.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea, a consumer goods company, and in SAP analytics consulting.

achievements.impact: I translated business requirements into KPI reporting and analysed company purchase data to support procurement decisions
I built DocuMind, an LLM application on the Claude API with an evaluation harness: 91% correct on a 22-question test set
I documented every dashboard I built and presented results to business users and a client

letter.problems_section: I would analyse marketing performance across your EU businesses, turn findings into clear recommendations and help build and test AI tools for reporting. E-commerce marketing is new to me, and I do not read Chinese.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Berlin and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
